title: Labels from every source: planted truth, measurements, people who chose otherwise, and blind reviewers with known weights
request: The owner wants decision models trained on DCLab's decisions; a decision without a label of what was right teaches nothing.
spec: Benchmark labels for decisions on replicas, measured labels (a leak's lift, a split's optimism), person labels from overrides (user_decision_exposed), and a blind labelling page on a sample drawn with known probabilities; the precedence blind, benchmark, measured, exposed as one function.
plan: The precedence and the blind draw in dclab_core, so both hosts weigh labels the same way.
Benchmark labels from a replica's declared traps after an acceptance run; exposed labels where a person was shown the rule's answer; measured labels where the leakage stage measures.
Routes and an Admin tab: the ledger's counts and blind labelling, for the owner and reviewers.

decisions.decision: An exposed label counts only when it contradicts an answer a rule or a model gave.
decisions.why: A person who saw the answer and agreed is not evidence it was right (the main product's rule: demote, never promote).

decisions.decision: Only planted traps are labelled on a replica, never 'not a leak' for the other columns.
decisions.why: A replica declares what was planted; an unplanted column may still leak by accident.

decisions.decision: The blind draw is a hash of the record's id against its stratum's probability.
decisions.why: Reproducible, and its probability is known before anyone labels: every blind label carries 1/p.

decisions.decision: Only points a reviewer can answer from what is shown are drawn, and a state field equal to the answer is hidden.
decisions.why: A value with no options stalled the queue; a revisit's state named the stage it revisited.

decisions.decision: Strata are whether the answers agree, not only rule against model.
decisions.why: Most studio decisions have no model answer; an override (rule against person) is the disagreement worth over-sampling.

change: dclab_core/ledger.py (effective_label, current_labels, stratum, blind_probability, blind_options, blind_eligible, blind_draw, blind_view; 0.9.0), dclab_rnd/ledger/labels.py (new), ledger/capture.py (exposed and measured labels), kinds/acceptance.py, agentic/pages/ledger.py (new), pages/__init__.py, server.py, accounts/guard.py, the Admin Decisions tab; tests/test_decision_labels.py (new), test_experience_log.py; CLAUDE.md, the plan, the roadmap.

findings.defect: The replica test expected a group label where no group decision was made.
findings.cause: The case never states a group column.
findings.fix: Label every decision made about a planted column; a decision not made is not labelled.

findings.defect: A measured split label was untested against an older split.
findings.scenario: Planted fault: labelling the latest split of any strategy passed.
findings.cause: The test's time split was also the latest.
findings.fix: The test adds a later group split.

findings.defect: An override's exposed label never counted.
findings.scenario: The person forbade a column the rule kept; effective_label returned none.
findings.cause: It compared the label with the value used, which is the person's own.
findings.fix: Count it when it contradicts a rule's or a model's answer.

findings.defect: Heuristics nobody saw wrote person labels.
findings.scenario: The leakage stage labelled zone as the person's exposed decision.
findings.cause: Every person-used record wrote an exposed label.
findings.fix: Only where the person was shown the rule's answer (a saved solution, an override).

findings.defect: Blind labels on yes/no points were wrong.
findings.scenario: Clicking run_stage on a move stored no.
findings.cause: A yes/no point showed its decision's options.
findings.fix: A yes/no point is answered yes or no.

findings.defect: The blind queue could stall for good.
findings.scenario: A split strategy with no options came first: no button, no skip.
findings.fix: Only points with options and a state that does not name the answer.

findings.defect: An empty or repeated blind label was accepted.
findings.scenario: A null value outranked the planted truth; one reviewer's second label doubled its weight.
findings.cause: No check on the value or on repeats.
findings.fix: Refuse an empty value and a second label by the same reviewer.

findings.defect: A blind view could show the answer.
findings.scenario: A revisit's state named the stage; a template's the pack.
findings.fix: Those points are not drawn; a state field equal to the answer is hidden.

findings.scenario: binary named its leak 'leak', time to event 'leaks'.

findings.cause: The stratum was rule against model only.
findings.fix: A stratum from whether any answers disagree.

measurements.name: planted faults
measurements.gate: each planted fault in the precedence, the draw, the labels and the route fails a test
measurements.result: 13 of 14 caught; the 14th (the route's empty-value check) is a second guard behind the label function's own

measurements.name: blind draw
measurements.gate: the drawn share per stratum matches its declared probability
measurements.result: agreeing decisions near 0.10, disagreeing near 0.60 over 2,000 each, reproducible

outcome: Decisions now carry what was right where it is known: planted truth on replicas, the leakage stage's measurements, people's corrections counted only when they correct, and a blind sample whose weights undo its own over-sampling.
lessons: A label's meaning depends on what its author saw: write exposed labels only where the answer was shown.
A queue that always serves the first item must be able to answer it, or it stalls.
risks: No replica declares its label key or family yet.
Who labels blind is the owner's decision.
